notes.title: February 8, Update
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just a quick fix today.
Some asset packs were not being saved correctly when you saved your scenes. This would cause them to not load when you later loaded or exported it. This has been fixed, however, you may still have to import the assets once more and re-save your scene.

Unfortunately, in an effort to make sure this doesn't happen again, all asset packs must be inside the Asset Pack folder in the Geovox install directory. This is the default location. If that is where you had them before, you will not need to change anything, but if you have asset packs that are not located there, you will need to move them.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: December 1, Update
notes.content:
Hi all,

We just added the ability to create water in your Geovox scenes.
To do this go to the bottom of the right side toolbar. 
You will see a section labeled Water. 
Enable the toggle and you will see the water appear in your current area. 
Adjust the settings as you see fit to make it look exactly how you want it to. 
There is a copy and paste function so you can take water settings from one area and apply it to another. Or you can press Use Default to return to the base settings.

As you edit, you can increase your area size from 300 to edit a larger area of water at the same time. This area is, as you probably know, shown by the large blue box surrounding you.

Water will export to Unity using the Scene Loader.
You will se an error that looks like:
-------------------
Instantiating material due to calling renderer.material during edit mode. This will leak materials into the scene. You most likely want to use renderer.sharedMaterial instead.
-------------------
This is a known bug, but required at the moment to import water and have it unique for each area.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Feb 23, 2016 Update - Export areas
notes.content:
Hi all.

We added the ability to toggle areas for export into Unity.

To use this, go to File > Toggle Area for Export
A red box will appear similar to your blue area box. You can use File > Toggle Area for Export again to turn it off again. You can also hide the red box if you wish in the Settings > Show Export Areas

Any area surrounded by this red box will be exported into Unity if you decide to, so if you want to export a level in a certain shape, such as an L shape, you can.

notes.title: Geovox Update 2015.6.23
notes.content:
Geovox Update 2015.6.23

Welcome to the most recent update of Geovox! In this new update we're continuing to stretch the limits of voxel terrain modelling with new features and fixes.

We've added new brush size options. Now you can have a brush setting up to 50! Previously, it was limited to 6. So, go ahead and carve out that whole crater, or build that mountain range! As well as giving the brush a larger range, we have added separate smoothing sliders for each brush function.

There is also a new GUI-free "Fly-Mode", for when you want soar over your terrain. Check the change log for other additions and fixes.

Oh, and we've added an "Undo" menu item to the "Edit" drop-down. You could always use CTRL-Z before, but it's more apparent that you can undo!

Change log. 

-MOD- Brush size now can be set to to 50.
-Fixed- Brush drawing while you are sliding the size slider.
-Fixed- Fog toggle
-Fixed- Terrain textures in the editor.
-Added- "Undo" to the drop-down: Edit>Undo
-Tuned- Adjusted reset height so it doesn't happen so often.
-Added- Fly Mode. No GUI. ESCape to get back
-Added- Separate smoothing for Add, Cut, Replace, And Cut/Paint
-Added- Brush now ignores prefabs.

Happy Creating...

Geovox Team

notes.title: Axis Game Factory's GeoVox Updates and Summer Sale on ALL Products
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that GeoVox now supports exporting the GeoVox terrain files into Unity 5.  What this means is that you can take your creations straight into Unity the same way that they appear in the GeoVox software.

GeoVox is the latest application by Axis Game Factory, Inc.  GeoVox is a completely new stand-alone Voxel based real-time terrain creation tool. Instantly create lush AAA quality environments from the start; carve, sculpt, and generate scenes like never before!  

Now through June 22nd, GeoVox is on SALE for 50% off!  In addition, our entire suite of Axis Game Factory’s AGFPRO is on sale for 75% off along with all DLC’s that include Premium, Zombie FPS, Fantasy Side-Scroller, Voxel Sculpt, Drone Kombat Multiplayer and BattleMat Multiplayer DLC’s.  

We have many, many more new features that we will be announcing in the coming weeks, so stay tuned and here is a list of this week’s updates below:

Version - 2015.06.11
- ADDED- Geovox Importers for Unity 5.0.* (App Installation Root Folder)
- ADDED- Current area to the save settings
- FIXED- The snapping issue after export
- ADDED- Q and E go directly up and down
- ADDED- RMB Q and E go up and down relative to the camera
- FIXED- Focus while looking into the distance
- ADDED- Export window
- FIXED- A placement error with the brush
- ADDED- Confirm quit
- ADDED- More highlight colors
- ADDED- Hotkeys and dig replace to the drop down
- ADDED- Hotkeys to drop down
- ADDED- Max camera height
- FIXED- Loading bar not disappearing
- ADDED- Reset position and reset height hotkeys added
- FIXED- Save only the asset packs that are being used
- ADDED- Secondary camera for non fog mode
- REMOVED- Align Prefabs to normals. will make better solution later
- ADDED- Dropdown>Settings>Toggle Fog
- ADDED- MMB drag moves the camera
- ADDED- Shift + F to Center and Zoom cursor location 
- ADDED- F to Center cursor location 
- ADDED- User name and account Login protocols
- ADDED- Random prefab creation chance
- UPDATE- Latest glow shaders
- FIXED- Sidebar menu slide speed
- ADDED- Dividers on sidebar menu
- ADDED- Voxel types have their own open closed states in the gui
- ADDED- About > change log button on drop down
- FIXED- Bring windows to the front when opened or selected 
- FIXED- Increased dropdown speed
- REMOVED- Smooth slider from editor window. At top tool bar now
- FIXED- Error that was making it crash when chunk size was changed
- ADDED- Importing of Heightmaps
- ADDED - Export heightmap
- FIXED- Add grass type error
- ADDED- Upper tool bar (just below the dropdown)
- ADDED- Automatic grid scaling to the Current area cube

notes.title: GeoVox is NOW LIVE!!!!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that we have just launched the latest and greatest stand-alone application in our suite of products, GeoVox!  Take your level building and creations to a whole new level with this amazing terrain creation toolkit!

GeoVox is the latest real time world generation software application created by Axis Game Factory, Inc.  GeoVox is a completely new stand-alone Voxel based real-time terrain creation tool. 

GeoVox instantly creates lush AAA quality environments at the start of the application.  Designed with intuitive game like controls it allows users to test for level playability as they are creating.  

Key Features:  
  User Experience
•	Instant environment is generated at application start 
•	Simple tools that allow users to edit the environment as needed without a steep learning curve
•	Clean, low overhead GUI that allows for fast terrain editing, without limiting users creativity
•	Standard game controls to allow users to explore their environment to simulate gameplay
•	Flying Camera or FPS style with gravity and jump ability camera modes
•	Full real-time Voxel based terrain editing
  o	  Easily edit the terrain with simple point and click volume brushes
  o	  Define Voxel brush sizes and shape
  o	  Single click and click and drag on Voxel application
  o	  Offset Voxel brush from center or base
  o	  Brush snapping
  o	  Add Voxel volumes
  o	  Cut Voxel volumes
  o	  Paint Voxel volumes
  o	  User definable smoothing 
  o	  Cut volumes and Paint textures and apply environmental assets simultaneously  
  o	  Create a pallet of Voxel types to be used in your environment
  o	  Voxel types can include textures, assets and vegetation
  o	  Mix and match variables to create many Voxel types
  o	  Voxel types can be applied upright or aligned to terrain normal
  o	  Assets can have user defined depth off-sets 
•	Fully featured fractal algorithmic terrain generator 
•	Limited or Infinite terrain editing abilities (user decides and determines how large they want their maps)
•	Create from hundreds of pre-packed, license free assets to use for professional development
•	Assets include:
  o	  Trees
  o	  Plants
  o	  Rocks
  o	  Shrubs
  o	  Flowers
  o	  Grasses
•	Library of terrain textures included with color, normal and specular maps
•	Real-Time, user defined Ambient Occlusion 

Input/Output
•	Create Asset Packs for use with Geovox using the AGF Asset packager and Unity FREE
•	Importing of AGF Asset Packs for use in Geovox
•	GeoVox to .Obj exporting
  o	  User defined export location
  o	  User defined export size
  o	  All mesh assets export with transforms applied 
  o	  All images export in .PNG format

Product Road Map of Future Updates / DLC - will be added at a later date
•	.Obj Importing directly into Geovox (future update)
•	Networked (8) user Environment Collaboration. Private (Password Protected) and open Rooms (future update)
•	Importing of the Geovox Terrain Format (Raw Mesh data) to Unity 5.0 (future update)
•	Importing of the Geovox Terrain Format to the AGFPRO Editor (future update)
•	Importing of the Geovox Terrain Format to the AGFPRO Player DLC (future update)
•	Package and Share your completed Geovox Terrains with an re-distributable Geovox Player (future update)
•	Importing of the Geovox Terrain Format to the AGFPRO editor (future update)
•      Asset Packager for use with Unity 5.0 Free to GeoVox asset package format (future DLC - additional cost)
